en: The image shows the back side of an old French postcard with handwritten cursive text in French covering most of the surface. Printed elements include the vertical words "CARTE POSTALE" on the right, typical dividing lines for correspondence and address, and a printer's mark mentioning "LEVASSEUR, LEVALLOIS‑PERRET". A date that appears to be 1916 is written at the top, and the card has no visible picture side in this image.
